blind-signatures.title: David Chaum’s Blind Signatures (1982)

cypherpunk-manifesto.title: Eric Hughes’ Cypherpunk Manifesto (1993)
cypherpunk-manifesto.description: Explore Eric Hughes’ 1993 Cypherpunk Manifesto and its argument for privacy through code, with illustrated history and the details inside the artwork.

hashcash.title: Adam Back’s Hashcash Announcement (1997)
hashcash.description: Explore Adam Back’s 1997 Hashcash announcement: computational postage that was costly to create and quick to check, brought to life in HISTROVE artwork.

rpow.title: Hal Finney’s Reusable Proof of Work (2004)
rpow.description: Discover Hal Finney’s 2004 RPOW experiment, its reusable proof-of-work tokens and the historical references in HISTROVE’s original illustration.

the-whitepaper.title: The Bitcoin Whitepaper (2008)

genesis-block.title: Bitcoin’s Genesis Block (2009)
genesis-block.description: Discover Bitcoin’s Genesis block, created on 3 January 2009, and the newspaper message inside it through HISTROVE’s illustrated crypto history.

the-overflow.title: Bitcoin’s Value Overflow Incident (2010)
the-overflow.description: Discover Bitcoin’s August 2010 value overflow incident and the repair that removed an invalid transaction, with the story and original HISTROVE artwork.

slush-pool.title: Slush Pool and Cooperative Bitcoin Mining (2010)
slush-pool.description: Explore Slush’s November 2010 proposal for cooperative Bitcoin mining, with original artwork, historical references and companion book pages.

wikileaks-bitcoin.title: WikiLeaks Accepts Bitcoin Donations (2011)
wikileaks-bitcoin.description: Explore WikiLeaks’ June 2011 announcement accepting Bitcoin donations during a payment blockade, with original artwork and the historical context.

casascius-coins.title: Casascius Physical Bitcoins (2011)
casascius-coins.description: Discover Mike Caldwell’s September 2011 Casascius coin launch, the physical coins and their concealed keys, through HISTROVE’s illustrated history.

litecoin-launches.title: Digital Silver: Litecoin’s Launch (2011)
litecoin-launches.description: Explore Litecoin’s public launch on 13 October 2011 and Charlie Lee’s role, with the original Digital Silver artwork, story and companion book pages.

the-first-halving.title: Bitcoin’s First Halving (2012)
the-first-halving.description: Discover Bitcoin’s first halving on 28 November 2012, when the block subsidy fell from 50 to 25 BTC, through original artwork and historical details.

silk-road-shutdown.title: Silk Road’s Shutdown (2013)
silk-road-shutdown.description: Explore Ross Ulbricht’s arrest and Silk Road’s shutdown in October 2013, with HISTROVE’s illustrated reconstruction and the story behind the scene.

cash-out.title: Cash Out: Vancouver’s Bitcoin ATM (2013)
cash-out.description: Explore the first permanent public Bitcoin ATM installation at Waves Coffee House in Vancouver, launched on 29 October 2013, with original artwork.

four-figures.title: Four Figures: Bitcoin Reaches $1,000 on Mt. Gox

ethereum-whitepaper.title: Ethereum’s Early Whitepaper (2013)
ethereum-whitepaper.description: Explore Ethereum’s November 2013 whitepaper milestone and Vitalik Buterin’s early proposal, with original artwork and the story before the network launch.

much-wow.title: Much Wow: Dogecoin’s Launch (2013)
much-wow.description: Discover Dogecoin’s launch on 6 December 2013 and the Kabosu-inspired meme behind it, with original Much Wow artwork, historical details and book pages.

buried-fortune.title: Buried Fortune: James Howells’ Lost Bitcoin Drive
buried-fortune.description: Discover the story of James Howells’ hard drive, discarded in Newport in 2013, and the lost access it represented through original HISTROVE artwork.

doge-goes-to-sochi.title: Doge Goes to Sochi: Jamaica’s Bobsleigh Fundraiser

mt-gox.title: Mt. Gox’s Insolvency Filing (2014)

monero-launches.title: Monero’s Launch (2014)

the-bitcoin-auction.title: The US Marshals’ Bitcoin Auction (2014)

the-ether-sale.title: Ethereum’s Ether Sale (2014)
the-ether-sale.description: Discover Ethereum’s public ether sale, opened on 22 July 2014 to fund development, through the story, original HISTROVE artwork and historical details.

keys-in-your-pocket.title: Keys in Your Pocket: Trezor’s Launch (2014)
keys-in-your-pocket.description: Explore the original Trezor hardware wallet’s launch on 29 July 2014 and its approach to isolating private keys, with original artwork and book pages.

the-dollar-token.title: The Dollar Token: Realcoin’s First Issuance (2014)
the-dollar-token.description: Discover Realcoin’s first token issuance on 6 October 2014, before the Tether rebrand, through original HISTROVE artwork and illustrated crypto history.

bitlicense.title: New York’s BitLicense Takes Effect (2015)
bitlicense.description: Explore New York’s BitLicense regulation taking effect on 24 June 2015, with historical context, original artwork and companion book pages.

ethereum-goes-live.title: Ethereum’s Frontier Launch (2015)
ethereum-goes-live.description: Discover Ethereum’s Frontier launch on 30 July 2015, from its genesis block to a programmable network, with original artwork and the story behind it.

the-split.description: Explore the Ethereum hard fork of 20 July 2016 following the DAO attack and the paths of Ethereum and Ethereum Classic, with original illustrated history.

the-bitfinex-heist.title: The Bitfinex Bitcoin Heist (2016)
the-bitfinex-heist.description: Discover the August 2016 Bitfinex theft, the exchange-custody failure and the story behind HISTROVE’s original illustration and companion book pages.

rare-pepes.title: Rare Pepes and Counterparty Collectibles (2016)
rare-pepes.description: Explore the first RAREPEPE issuance on 9 September 2016 and the early Counterparty collecting community, with original artwork and historical details.

the-zcash-ceremony.title: The Zcash Trusted-Setup Ceremony (2016)
the-zcash-ceremony.description: Discover the October 2016 Zcash trusted-setup ceremony, its six participants and security assumptions through original artwork and historical references.

cryptopunks.title: CryptoPunks by Larva Labs (2017)

behind-the-chair.title: Behind the Chair: Bitcoin Sign Guy (2017)

binance-launches.title: Binance’s Exchange Launch (2017)

bitcoin-cash-fork.title: The Bitcoin Cash Fork (2017)
bitcoin-cash-fork.description: Discover the Bitcoin Cash fork of 1 August 2017 and the block-size debate, with original HISTROVE artwork, historical context and companion book pages.

segwit-activates.title: Bitcoin’s SegWit Activation (2017)

china-bans-icos.title: China’s ICO Ban (2017)
china-bans-icos.description: Explore China’s joint regulatory notice on token fundraising on 4 September 2017, with historical context and the story behind HISTROVE’s original artwork.

the-missing-cryptoqueen.title: The Missing Cryptoqueen: Ruja Ignatova and OneCoin

bitconnect.title: BitConnect’s Pattaya Ceremony (2017)

cryptokitties.title: CryptoKitties’ Ethereum Launch (2017)

dai-goes-live.title: MakerDAO’s Dai Launch (2017)
dai-goes-live.description: Explore MakerDAO’s Dai launch on 18 December 2017, its Ether-backed CDPs and soft dollar target, with original artwork, historical details and book pages.

lightning-goes-live.title: Lightning’s First Mainnet Beta (2018)

uniswap-launches.title: Uniswap Launches on Ethereum (2018)
uniswap-launches.description: Explore Uniswap’s launch on 2 November 2018, paired ETH and ERC20 reserves and constant-product swaps, with original artwork, historical clues and book pages.

the-pineapple-fund.title: The Pineapple Fund: Bitcoin Giving (2018)

quadrigacx.title: QuadrigaCX: Balances Without Backing (2019)
quadrigacx.description: Explore QuadrigaCX’s 2019 collapse and the OSC staff review, with original artwork, four visual clues and the distinction between missing keys and missing assets.

lightning-torch.title: Lightning Torch: Pass It On (2019)
lightning-torch.description: Explore Hodlonaut’s 2019 Lightning Torch relay, from a 100,000-satoshi start to a global trust experiment, with Portofino-inspired artwork and four visual clues.

chainlink-mainnet.title: Chainlink Mainnet Launch on Ethereum (2019)
